title.en: Picket fence section on a boarded floor

alt.tr: Tahta zemin üzerinde duran, yatay iki çıta ile birleşen sivri uçlu çit parçası, arkada taş duvar
alt.en: Pointed picket fence section on a boarded floor, joined by two horizontal rails, with a stone wall behind

caption.tr: Çıtalar iki yatay kuşakla sabitlenmiş. Altındaki zemin de aynı bal tonunda.
caption.en: The pickets are fixed with two horizontal rails. The floor beneath has the same honey tone.
